## PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Marlon Avery is a visionary Chief AI Officer, founder, and educator with 10+ years stewarding frontier innovations from lab to market. He is expert at orchestrating Generative AI, Voice AI, OCR–LLM pipelines, and LLMOps to unlock measurable impact — boosting efficiency up to 60%, slashing costs 40%, and certifying the next wave of AI talent.

As VP, Applied AI Lead at JPMorgan Chase and CEO of VoicePath — an AI agency specializing in custom voice solutions — Marlon spearheads the design and deployment of AI-powered systems revolutionizing healthcare, insurance, finance, and legal: automating processes, reducing inefficiencies, and elevating customer experience. He is adept at scaling cross-functional engineering teams, crafting revenue-driven product roadmaps, and delivering high-stakes workshops for Microsoft, Google, and Dream Machine Innovation Labs.

## CHAMPION OF AI INNOVATION

### VoicePath AI — Founder & CEO / Chief AI Officer (Jan 2025 – Present, Washington, DC)

- Improved patient communication response times by 60% and reduced administrative workload by 50% by integrating an AI Phone Agent into a Neuroscience Office's Medical Practice Management system, handling incoming calls, appointment scheduling, and after-visit summaries.
- Accelerated patient outreach 60% and reduced admin workload 50% by deploying a HIPAA-compliant AI Phone Agent integrated with **Veradigm EHR**.
- Launched a portfolio of outbound and receptionist voice agents (CRM updates, insurance verification, payments) cutting customer-service costs up to 40% for early adopters in healthcare, finance, legal, and insurance.
- Shortened deployment cycles 50% by leading a cross-functional team of engineers and compliance advisors through a secure, reusable voice-AI framework aligned with HIPAA and SOC-2 controls.

### AImpact — Head of AI & CEO, AI Training (May 2023 – Present, Remote)

- Contracted by **Microsoft** to architect and lead Azure OpenAI bootcamps — spotlighting OCR + Azure AI Document Intelligence solutions along with technical resources (Jupyter Notebooks, Azure AI Studio) — boosting engineer certification pass-rates 30% and shepherding cohorts from ideation to production.
- Taught 10,000+ professionals across 80+ workshops and keynotes, delivering a 40% average productivity lift by translating frontier research (LLM-powered RAG, LangChain, vector DBs) into pragmatic workflows.
- Commissioned by **Dream Machine Innovation Labs** — in partnership with **Google** — to author the curriculum and headline workshops for a five-city *AI Library Project* tour, delivering GenAI training to underserved communities.
- Bridged strategy and execution for Fortune 1000 and public-sector clients, cutting AI time-to-value 50% via bespoke roadmaps prioritizing high-impact GenAI, NLP, and automation use cases.
- Spearheaded R&D and productization of ML/LLM solutions (summarization, multilingual Q&A, generative voice bots), accelerating project timelines 50% through modular architectures and third-party integrations.

### LiveRamp — Staff Technical Program Manager, Data Connectivity Platform (Apr 2022 – Jan 2023, Remote)

- Directed cross-team and dependency alignment, defining clear and predictable processes to launch LiveRamp's Authenticated Traffic Solution (ATS) Forecasting tool, enabling a 20% increase in client adoption.

- Drove API integration, onboarding, support, and documentation programs that streamlined cross-team execution.
- Partnered with executive leadership (CTO, Head of TPM, Head of Product) to align team KPIs with company initiatives.

### Lightship Capital — Engineering Director / Interim CTO (Apr 2020 – Apr 2022, Remote)

- Served as interim CTO leading 25+ engineers across 7 portfolio companies, advising on advanced AI integration, engineering processes, and product development strategies.
- Built one of the first AI Grant Writers on GPT-3 (2021) — a text-generation tool uniting company knowledge and semantic search to generate prompts for grant submissions, enhancing grant response throughput 2.5x and delivering a 60% reduction in work labor.
- Led the design and implementation of a transformative time-efficiency initiative, harnessing data analytics to optimize organizational productivity by 50%.
